title: A post for a florist
situation: Rosa's Flowers, a florist client, runs a Mother's Day offer: 15% off all bouquets until Sunday, with free delivery in town. They want a post for their Instagram page.
goal: Write a prompt that gets the AI to draft the post.

details.label: Who the AI should be
details.hint: Who should the AI be? A social media manager knows how posts work.

details.label: A social media post
details.hint: What should it write? Say it's a social media post.

details.label: The shop's name
details.hint: Who is it for? Name the shop: Rosa's Flowers.

details.label: The offer
details.hint: What's the offer? The AI needs the facts: 15% off all bouquets.

details.label: When it ends
details.hint: Until when? Say the offer ends on Sunday.

details.label: Where it will be posted
details.hint: Where will it be posted? Instagram posts have their own style.

details.label: The tone
details.hint: What tone? Warm and joyful suits Mother's Day.

details.label: A call to action
details.hint: What should readers do? Ask for a call to action, like order before Sunday.

details.label: An example to follow
details.hint: Bonus: give an example of a post you liked, so the AI can follow the style.

details.label: A rule to respect
details.hint: Bonus: add a rule, like no more than 3 hashtags.

conflicts.explain: Formal and playful at the same time? The roof cracks. Pick one voice for the post.

answers.vague: Check out our flowers! We have a great offer for Mother's Day. Don't miss it!
answers.passable: Mother's Day is coming! Rosa's Flowers has a special offer on bouquets this week. Visit us to find the perfect gift for your mum.
answers.excellent: Mum deserves flowers that say it all. This Mother's Day, Rosa's Flowers takes 15% off every bouquet, and we deliver for free in town. The offer ends Sunday, so order today via the link in our bio and make her smile. #MothersDay #RosasFlowers

ada.intro: Level 2: no more blocks to fill. Write your prompt in your own words, and I'll point out what's missing while you type.
ada.success: Beautiful, the building holds. The AI had the shop, the offer, the platform and the call to action.
ada.takeaway: In free text the blocks are still there: you just write them as sentences.

input.text: You are a social media manager. Write an Instagram post for Rosa's Flowers about their Mother's Day discount.

You are a social media manager. Write an Instagram post for Rosa's Flowers, a florist. The offer: 15% off all bouquets until Sunday, with free delivery in town. Make it warm and joyful, and end with a call to action to order via the link in bio.

You are a social media manager. Write an Instagram post for Rosa's Flowers, a florist. The offer: 15% off all bouquets until Sunday, with free delivery in town. Make it warm and joyful, and end with a call to action to order via the link in bio. Don't use more than 3 hashtags.
